description: The agent must: (1) Read career_background_raw.txt and target_jd_bytedance.txt to extract real data. (2) Create career_profile_package.json with multiple sections. (3) Set 职业标签 to exactly 3-5 keywords (proprietary trap: must not use all 20+ listed, must curate to 3-5 per 脉脉 rules). (4) Write at least 2 STAR-format achievements with all 4 labeled components (S/T/A/R) AND quantified numbers extracted from the messy notes (e.g., 300张表→80张, T+1→5分钟, 日活100万→800万). (5) Write a 内推求职 outreach message containing the target position, years of experience, a quantified achievement, and an explicit referral request — following the specific template structure from the skill. (6) Specify content posting frequency as 2-3 times per week AND name the correct time windows (8-9am and/or 12-13pm) — not generic advice. (7) Include a salary negotiation strategy that explicitly mentions the 110-120% pricing rule (ask for 110-120% of target, not just 'ask for more').
